The '''Ranger transceiver''' was a model of [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transceiver]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==Description==
The Ranger transceiver was produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] for use aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]]. The unit had a range of one hundred [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]], and was capable of monitoring over three hundred [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] frequencies. The Ranger monitored the subspace spectrum, altering frequencies every tenth of a [[Standard second|second]]. Any messages intercepted by the transceiver could be decoded by the encryption [[Computer/Legends|computer]] built into the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] [[com-scan]] system.<ref name="EGWT" />
